short: A capability category testing whether AI can solve unfamiliar problems by reasoning, not by recalling something similar from training.
definition: Novel problem-solving, as a capability category, measures whether an AI can handle problems it has not effectively seen before — working out a solution from reasoning and general principles rather than matching something memorized during training. It targets genuine flexibility and generalization: the ability to face a fresh puzzle with unfamiliar rules and figure it out. Benchmarks like ARC-AGI are built specifically to resist memorization, so they serve as a proxy for this skill, and models still struggle badly on the hardest versions, which makes it a closely watched axis of progress.
